sources.snippet: What is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B? It is the latest open model released by Alibaba in April 2026. The license is Apache 2.0, so commercial use is free. The biggest feature of this model is an architecture called MoE (Mixture of Experts). The total parameter count is 35B, but only 3B are active during inference. This is the meaning of 'A3B' in the model name.
